operations.summary: Describes the documents and directories available within a specific 'aspect' (content group) of the BCLaws library
Lists the metadata available for the specified index or directory from the BCLaws legislative respository
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME]  [PATH] content [PARAMS] aspect civix document id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: The /document API allows you to retrieve actual documents from the BCLaws legislative repository. To retrieve a document from the repository you need the aspect identifier and two other specific pieces of information about the document: the index identifier and the document identifier. These unique identifiers can be retrieved from the /content API.
